_comment: What tools/convert-3mf.mjs exports. Every piece comes from 'Factory Speghetti AMS.3mf' (the designer's current file). 'item' picks a build item on the print plate (by triangle count of the whole item, by object name, or by index); 'partIndex' takes one copy out of an assembly of copies; 'parts' keeps only the named parts. Colours come from the filament number of each part and from per-triangle paint, mapped to material names by 'filamentRoles' (colours in piece-theme.json).

pieces.name: mine-1
pieces.title: Mine 1 (starting mine)
pieces.notes: Hex centres at x = -34.4 (rayed hex) and x = +34.4 (second hex). Its body is painted filament 10 (grey #A0A0A0) in the print file; the designer asked for it to be the same white as the other board pieces, so filament 10 maps to body.

pieces.notes: The chain is one closed mesh (the links are joined), so it is exported whole; no separate link or arrowhead models.

pieces.name: control-module
pieces.title: Control Module tile
pieces.notes: One tile body (part Body12) of the Number Tiles AMS set, turned face up (it prints face down); the engraved numeral is filled flat (numerals are meant to be textures).

pieces.name: control-module-tray
pieces.title: Control Module tray
pieces.notes: The 3 x 6 pocket half of the two-part tray assembly (the other half, a flat lid-like panel, is not exported). Turned square to the axes: it sits at 45 degrees on the print plate.
